station_line_format: ID(1-11) LATITUDE(13-20) LONGITUDE(22-30) ELEVATION_m(32-37) STATE(39-40) NAME(42-71) GSN(73-75) HCN/CRN(77-79) WMO(81-85), from ghcnd-stations.txt
name: SEATTLE TACOMA AP

columns.date: observation day, YYYY-MM-DD, as given in the GHCN DATE field
columns.TMAX: daily maximum temperature, tenths of degC (native GHCN units)
columns.TMIN: daily minimum temperature, tenths of degC (native GHCN units)
columns.PRCP: daily precipitation, tenths of mm (native GHCN units)
columns.AWND: average daily wind speed, tenths of m/s (native GHCN units)
columns.<EL>_M: measurement flag, from readme.txt: blank = no measurement information applicable; T = trace of precipitation (the only non-blank M flag for these four elements at this station)
columns.<EL>_Q: quality flag, from readme.txt: blank = did not fail any quality assurance check; O = failed climatological outlier check (the only non-blank Q flag here)
columns.<EL>_S: source flag, from readme.txt: 0 = U.S. Cooperative Summary of the Day (NCDC DSI-3200); D = short time delay US National Weather Service CF6 daily summaries; W = WBAN/ASOS Summary of the Day from NCDC's Integrated Surface Data; X = U.S. First-Order Summary of the Day (NCDC DSI-3210); Z = Datzilla official additions or replacements
columns.missing value: empty cell = element not reported that day
